<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def head_col():
    a = current_frame.ascii.splitlines()
    # head: contiguous b/S run in rows 19-22, cols >= 18
    row = a[20]
    cols = [c for c in range(18,64) if row[c] in 'bS']
    if not cols: return None
    # group contiguous
    groups=[]; start=cols[0]; prev=cols[0]
    for c in cols[1:]:
        if c==prev+1: prev=c
        else: groups.append((start,prev)); start=c; prev=c
    groups.append((start,prev))
    return groups

print('start head:', head_col())
for i in range(6):
    action(['LEFT'])
    print('after LEFT', i+1, 'head:', head_col(), 'changed:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def head_col():
    a = current_frame.ascii.splitlines()
    # head: contiguous b/S run in rows 19-22, cols >= 18
    row = a[20]
    cols = [c for c in range(18,64) if row[c] in 'bS']
    if not cols: return None
    # group contiguous
    groups=[]; start=cols[0]; prev=cols[0]
    for c in cols[1:]:
        if c==prev+1: prev=c
        else: groups.append((start,prev)); start=c; prev=c
    groups.append((start,prev))
    return groups

print('start head:', head_col())

    print('after LEFT', i+1, 'head:', head_col(), 'changed:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
